turnout.notes: Massachusetts turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. The official Massachusetts turnout statistics page confirms the same 2024 statewide registered-voter and total-votes-cast figures, but no state-native local turnout denominator artifact is loaded.

reviewCharts.warning: Massachusetts review rows are official PD43+ city/town, ward, and precinct rows comparing President against U.S. Senate. Jurisdiction grouping is municipality-centric because the PD43+ bulk export does not include county in the row schema.

historicalBaselines.warning: Massachusetts historical baseline rows are official PD43+ county-level presidential results for 2012, 2016, and 2020. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data; the 2020 county rows preserve the official displayed county-row sum, which is one non-D/R vote above the statewide summary line.
